title: StreamK → WorldK NarrativeContext v1
description: INFORMATIONAL-ONLY narrative arrival context, parsed by WorldK from the URL StreamK's existing buildWorldHandoffUrl() already emits (streamk-web/lib/storyWorldGateway.ts). SOURCE: StreamK. Handoff semantics shared by StreamK/WorldK. Authority over world state, world history, visitor memory or runtime: NONE. It can only explain arrival ("You watched …") and carry a place HINT. URL mapping (unchanged StreamK params): story→storySlug, episode→episodeSlug, entry→entryExperienceId, place→placeHint, signal/signalMode/cue→continuity. The worldId comes from the WorldK URL path, never a query param. IGNORED BY WORLDK: avatarKId, anon (identity comes only from the verified AvatarK session). Unknown params are dropped. Invalid values drop the whole context (arrival treated as organic).

placeHint.description: Semantic place HINT (StreamK WorldEntryContext.placeId). The platform may honor or ignore it at ENTER; it never asserts the place's state.

worldStateAuthority.description: Structural guard: NarrativeContext can never be read as world state.
